description: Hadroma wears a rust-red floor-length wool overdress over ivory linen, with a modest neckline near the collarbones, wrist-length sleeves, decorated woven borders at the collar, cuffs and hem, and a broad belt with a circular buckle and hanging ornamented strap. A plum mantle, secured by a round brooch, hangs from one shoulder. Both brown leather shoes are visible.
